attributes.title: 2027 Capital Region Dental Convention: SDDS MidWinter in Bloom
attributes.summary:
This two-day Sacramento convention offers 13 hours of CE on March 18 and 19, 2027. California licensees get a practical bonus: courses are labeled Core or 20% to match Dental Board of California renewal categories, so you can see how a course counts before you sit down.

The lowest rate ended November 9, 2026. Through February 28, 2027, an ADA member dentist pays $485 for both days, against $950 for a non-ADA member, and prices rise again on March 1. Written cancellations by February 19, 2027 get a refund minus $25, and the same date is the hotel cutoff for the $259 Sheraton Grand rate.

Hygienists teach several sessions, and the auxiliary rate sits well below the dentist price. One hands-on adhesive course costs $89 extra and is for dentists only.
